command: Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss tt zzz'; hostname; whoami; $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cs=Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; [pscustomobject]@{Caption=$os.Caption;Version=$os.Version;LastBoot=$os.LastBootUpTime;PartOfDomain=$cs.PartOfDomain;Workgroup=$cs.Workgroup;Cores=$cs.NumberOfLogicalProcessors;MemoryGiB=[math]::Round($cs.TotalPhysicalMemory/1GB,2)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-Service sshd,QEMU-GA | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object IPAddress -ne '127.0.0.1' | Select-Object IPAddress,PrefixLength | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 | Measure-Object | Select-Object Count | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' | Select-Object AutoAdminLogon,@{n='StoredAutoLogonPassword';e={$null -ne $_.DefaultPassword}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-NetFirewallRule -Name OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP | Select-Object Enabled,Profile,Action | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; & C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\sshd.exe -T | Select-String '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|allowusers) '; Get-Volume C | Select-Object DriveLetter,Size,SizeRemaining | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
